scope: Real Chrome on Windows; desktop and 390px touch emulation; isolated test storage. Physical phones, native Safari, physical gamepads and long-duration play are unverified.
checks: The title enables solo and disables online entry
First entry runs and autosaves a local character, outfit and one companion
Title/reload restores the same person, inventory and location while applying new clothes
A second tab cannot overwrite a live game and can resume after the first returns to title
390px touch flow keeps both title buttons visible and runs solo after separate character and companion screens
Native Chrome touch moves, cancellation stops, jump works, and the menu saves the moved position
No WebSocket or game API request
